newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skandia shares jump on foreign interest.
newsitem.headline: Skandia shares jump on foreign interest.

text.p: Shares in Swedish insurer Skandia AB jumped on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Thursday, fuelled by foreign interest.
At 1550 GMT, the share was up 14 crowns at 239 crowns, while the general index was up 1.06 percent at a record high of 2,744.40.

The share rebounded strongly after slipping three crowns on Wednesday when the company released 1996 earnings showing a pre-tax profit of 1.65 billion crowns, up from 1.55 billion crowns a year earlier.
"We have bought Skandia for a long time and the report partly confirmed our positive view," an analyst said.
"There is also a focus on unit linked operations where growth is extremely high and where profits don't seem far off."
